name: 44273 · Seville, OH
findings: ZIP 44273 (Seville) has 33 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44273 (Seville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 44273 (Seville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 21% of all organizations here have no identified type.
